notes:
Account background: Sentrya is a cloud-first contact center vendor that also runs managed on-prem connectors for enterprise telco customers. Primary objective: replace legacy rules-based assist with LLM-driven agent assist + automated summarization and tool-calls into Zendesk/ServiceNow.

Recent timeline: 
- 2024-10-22: Intro call (Avery) — discussed 24/7 global support needs, current SLAs, peak spikes on Black Friday-like events.
- 2024-11-05: Technical deep dive w/ infra + security (Diego) — asked about dedicated pools, kernel/quantization support, KMS integrations.
- 2024-11-18: POC kickoff (ff_2024-11-18_9903) — running small pilot with 50 agents, Llama-2-13B quantized candidate.
- 2024-11-30: POC interim review — model quality good for summaries, latency acceptable with batching but poor under simulated 1k concurrent agents.
- 2024-12-01: Capacity planning call (ff_2024-12-01_11022) — procurement requested committed throughput and cost predictability.

Technical requirements / ask: 
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) for 24/7 operations across NA/EU/APAC; isolation for multi-tenant customers.
- Throughput: sustain 1,000+ concurrent agent sessions at peak (target 1,200 req/s).
- Latency SLA: p95 < 300ms for short agent prompts; soft target p50 < 120ms for streaming responses.
- Tool-calling: must support function/tool calling to trigger ticket actions (create/update/resolve) with idempotency guarantees.
- Spiky traffic handling: automatic burst headroom or predictable overflow to fallback models with graceful degradation.
- Models: open-model preference; ability to pin model version and have smaller fallback variants.
- Data: require EU data residency for EU customers, 1 year retention controls, full audit logs, KMS-managed keys.

Security & procurement notes: 
- SOC2 Type II required; ISO27001 is a plus. SSO via SAML mandatory.
- Procurement needs a third-party security assessment (3rd party pen test report).
- On-prem connector: limited egress policy; need architecture diagram + runbook.

POC results & feedback: 
- Summarization quality high (F1-style eval on internal prompt set ~0.78).
- Agent assist context window handling needs KV cache optimization; repeated context causes rate/cost blow-up.
- Under synthetic spike test (2x expected peak) response latency rose >2x; customer wants guaranteed fallbacks and reserved burst capacity.

Next steps / owner actions: 
- Avery to send revised SOW and committed throughput tiers (due 2024-12-09).
- Diego to run a dedicated capacity simulation on Redwood Dedicated and provide p95 estimates by 2024-12-08.
- Security to schedule SAML + KMS integration workshop with Sentrya infra team week of 2024-12-11.

Customer quote snippets: 
- "We need predictable performance during US peak and EU morning overlap — can't have model timeouts during ticket handoffs."
- "If you can guarantee isolation and committed throughput, procurement will move fast."
